create_ImageNetTrain_dataset: create an ImageNetTrain dataset instance with optional random crop and size config
create_ImageNetValidation_dataset: create an ImageNetValidation dataset instance to load and organize ImageNet validation data
use_str_to_indices: use str_to_indices to parse a comma-separated range string into a sorted list of integers
use_get_preprocessor: use get_preprocessor to build an albumentations pipeline with resizing, cropping, and optional flip
use_ImageNetTrainWithDepth: use ImageNetTrainWithDepth to load ImageNet training images paired with RGBA depth maps
